content.title: Hut 8 and Fluidstack lease data center, Coursera to merge with Udemy
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Hut 8's (HUT) $7 billion investment with Fluidstack to lease a data center in Louisiana, Jabil (JBL) topping fiscal first quarter earnings and revenue estimates, and Coursera (COUR) merging with Udemy (UDMY) in a deal valued at $2.5 billion.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
